build_autoregressive_predictor: build a Predictor wrapping a one-step Predictor to make multi-step autoregressive weather predictions
run_autoregressive_prediction: run the Predictor call method with inputs, targets_template, and forcings to get multi-step predictions
test_autoregressive_loss: test the Predictor loss method to compute mean per-timestep losses across all autoregressive steps
review_gradient_checkpointing: review the Predictor gradient checkpointing option to save memory during multi-step autoregressive computation
refactor_update_inputs: refactor the _update_inputs method to maintain a rolling window of inputs with new predictions appended
